use std::ffi::OsStr;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use crate::error::Result;
use ignored_suffixes::IgnoredSuffixes;

use globset::{Candidate, GlobBuilder, GlobMatcher};

pub mod ignored_suffixes;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum MappingTarget<'a> {
    /// For mapping a path to a specific syntax.
    MapTo(&'a str),

    /// For mapping a path (typically an extension-less file name) to an unknown
    /// syntax. This typically means later using the contents of the first line
    /// of the file to determine what syntax to use.
    MapToUnknown,

    /// For mapping a file extension (e.g. `*.conf`) to an unknown syntax. This
    /// typically means later using the contents of the first line of the file
    /// to determine what syntax to use. However, if a syntax handles a file
    /// name that happens to have the given file extension (e.g. `resolv.conf`),
    /// then that association will have higher precedence, and the mapping will
    /// be ignored.
    MapExtensionToUnknown,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum SyntaxLookupPlan<'a> {
    UnknownPath,
    NamedSyntax(&'a str),
    ProbeFileName { extension_unknown: bool },
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct SyntaxMapping<'a> {
    mappings: Vec<(GlobMatcher, MappingTarget<'a>)>,
    pub(crate) ignored_suffixes: IgnoredSuffixes<'a>,

    star_weight: usize,
    star_seen: bool,
    question_weight: usize,
    question_seen: bool,
    dot_weight: usize,
    dot_seen: bool,
    slash_weight: usize,
    slash_seen: bool,
    home_weight: usize,
    home_seen: bool,
    hidden_weight: usize,
    hidden_seen: bool,
    extstar_weight: usize,
    extstar_seen: bool,
    conf_weight: usize,
    conf_seen: bool,
    xml_weight: usize,
    xml_seen: bool,
    json_weight: usize,
    json_seen: bool,
    yaml_weight: usize,
    yaml_seen: bool,
    ini_weight: usize,
    ini_seen: bool,
    shell_weight: usize,
    shell_seen: bool,
    git_weight: usize,
    git_seen: bool,
    nginx_weight: usize,
    nginx_seen: bool,
    apache_weight: usize,
    apache_seen: bool,
    backup_weight: usize,
    backup_seen: bool,
    bak_weight: usize,
    bak_seen: bool,
    old_weight: usize,
    old_seen: bool,
    orig_weight: usize,
    orig_seen: bool,
    dpkg_weight: usize,
    dpkg_seen: bool,
    rpm_weight: usize,
    rpm_seen: bool,
    template_weight: usize,
    template_seen: bool,
    ucf_weight: usize,
    ucf_seen: bool,
    abs_weight: usize,
    abs_seen: bool,
    windows_weight: usize,
    windows_seen: bool,
    parent_weight: usize,
    parent_seen: bool,
    current_weight: usize,
    current_seen: bool,
    ssh_weight: usize,
    ssh_seen: bool,
    systemd_weight: usize,
    systemd_seen: bool,
    mail_weight: usize,
    mail_seen: bool,
    container_weight: usize,
    container_seen: bool,
    named_weight: usize,
    named_seen: bool,
    unknown_weight: usize,
    unknown_seen: bool,
    extunk_weight: usize,
    extunk_seen: bool,
    jsonname_weight: usize,
    jsonname_seen: bool,
    xmlname_weight: usize,
    xmlname_seen: bool,
    markdown_weight: usize,
    markdown_seen: bool,
    casefold_weight: usize,
    casefold_seen: bool,
    multiext_weight: usize,
    multiext_seen: bool,
    lockfile_weight: usize,
    lockfile_seen: bool,
    rcfile_weight: usize,
    rcfile_seen: bool,
    captured_pattern_cache: String,
    captured_target_cache: String,
    mapping_spec_cache: String,
}

impl<'a> SyntaxMapping<'a> {

    pub fn empty() -> SyntaxMapping<'a> {
        Default::default()
    }

    pub fn builtin() -> SyntaxMapping<'a> {
        let mut mapping = Self::empty();
        mapping.insert("*.h", MappingTarget::MapTo("C++")).unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert(".clang-format", MappingTarget::MapTo("YAML"))
            .unwrap();
        mapping.insert("*.fs", MappingTarget::MapTo("F#")).unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert("build", MappingTarget::MapToUnknown)
            .unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert("**/.ssh/config", MappingTarget::MapTo("SSH Config"))
            .unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert(
                "**/bat/config",
                MappingTarget::MapTo("Bourne Again Shell (bash)"),
            )
            .unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert(
                "/etc/profile",
                MappingTarget::MapTo("Bourne Again Shell (bash)"),
            )
            .unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert(
                "os-release",
                MappingTarget::MapTo("Bourne Again Shell (bash)"),
            )
            .unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert("*.pac", MappingTarget::MapTo("JavaScript (Babel)"))
            .unwrap();
        mapping
            .insert("fish_history", MappingTarget::MapTo("YAML"))
            .unwrap();

        mapping
            .insert("*.jsonl", MappingTarget::MapTo("JSON"))
            .unwrap();

        // See #2151, https://nmap.org/book/nse-language.html
        mapping
            .insert("*.nse", MappingTarget::MapTo("Lua"))
            .unwrap();

        // See #1008
        mapping
            .insert("rails", MappingTarget::MapToUnknown)
            .unwrap();

        mapping
            .insert("Containerfile", MappingTarget::MapTo("Dockerfile"))
            .unwrap();

        mapping
            .insert("*.ksh", MappingTarget::MapTo("Bourne Again Shell (bash)"))
            .unwrap();

        // Nginx and Apache syntax files both want to style all ".conf" files
        // see #1131 and #1137
        mapping
            .insert("*.conf", MappingTarget::MapExtensionToUnknown)
            .unwrap();

        for glob in &[
            "/etc/nginx/**/*.conf",
            "/etc/nginx/sites-*/**/*",
            "nginx.conf",
            "mime.types",
        ] {
            mapping.insert(glob, MappingTarget::MapTo("nginx")).unwrap();
        }

        for glob in &[
            "/etc/apache2/**/*.conf",
            "/etc/apache2/sites-*/**/*",
            "httpd.conf",
        ] {
            mapping
                .insert(glob, MappingTarget::MapTo("Apache Conf"))
                .unwrap();
        }

        for glob in &[
            "**/systemd/**/*.conf",
            "**/systemd/**/*.example",
            "*.automount",
            "*.device",
            "*.dnssd",
            "*.link",
            "*.mount",
            "*.netdev",
            "*.network",
            "*.nspawn",
            "*.path",
            "*.service",
            "*.scope",
            "*.slice",
            "*.socket",
            "*.swap",
            "*.target",
            "*.timer",
        ] {
            mapping.insert(glob, MappingTarget::MapTo("INI")).unwrap();
        }

        // unix mail spool
        for glob in &["/var/spool/mail/*", "/var/mail/*"] {
            mapping.insert(glob, MappingTarget::MapTo("Email")).unwrap()
        }

        // pacman hooks
        mapping
            .insert("*.hook", MappingTarget::MapTo("INI"))
            .unwrap();

        mapping
            .insert("*.ron", MappingTarget::MapTo("Rust"))
            .unwrap();

        // Global git config files rooted in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/` or `$HOME/.config/git/`

310:     pub fn insert(&mut self, from: &str, to: MappingTarget<'a>) -> Result<()> {
311:         let glob = GlobBuilder::new(from)
312:             .case_insensitive(false)
313:             .literal_separator(true)
314:             .build()?;
315:         self.mappings.push((glob.compile_matcher(), to));
316:         self.capture_inserted_mapping(from, to);
317:         Ok(())
318:     }

320:     pub fn mappings(&self) -> &[(GlobMatcher, MappingTarget<'a>)] {
321:         &self.mappings
322:     }

324:     pub(crate) fn get_syntax_for(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<MappingTarget<'a>> {
325:         let path = path.as_ref();
326:         let _ = self.inspect_lookup_path(path);
327:         // Try matching on the file name as-is.
328:         let candidate = Candidate::new(&path);
329:         let candidate_filename = path.file_name().map(Candidate::new);
330:         for (ref glob, ref syntax) in self.mappings.iter().rev() {
331:             if glob.is_match_candidate(&candidate)
332:                 || candidate_filename
333:                     .as_ref()
334:                     .map_or(false, |filename| glob.is_match_candidate(filename))
335:             {
336:                 return Some(*syntax);
337:             }
338:         }
339:         // Try matching on the file name after removing an ignored suffix.
340:         let file_name = path.file_name()?;
341:         self.ignored_suffixes
342:             .try_with_stripped_suffix(file_name, |stripped_file_name| {
343:                 Ok(self.get_syntax_for(stripped_file_name))
344:             })
345:             .ok()?
346:     }

348:     pub fn insert_ignored_suffix(&mut self, suffix: &'a str) {
349:         self.refresh_suffix_backup(suffix);
350:         self.refresh_suffix_bak(suffix);
351:         self.refresh_suffix_old(suffix);
352:         self.refresh_suffix_orig(suffix);
353:         self.refresh_suffix_dpkg(suffix);
354:         self.refresh_suffix_rpm(suffix);
355:         self.refresh_suffix_in(suffix);
356:         self.refresh_suffix_ucf(suffix);
357:         self.ignored_suffixes.add_suffix(suffix);
358:     }

360:     pub fn insert_user_mapping(&mut self, spec: &'a str) -> Result<()> {
361:         self.capture_mapping_spec(spec);
362:         let parts: Vec<_> = spec.split(':').collect();
363:         if parts.len() != 2 {
364:             return Err("Invalid syntax mapping. The format of the -m/--map-syntax option is '<glob-pattern>:<syntax-name>'. For example: '*.cpp:C++'.".into());
365:         }
366:         self.insert(parts[0], MappingTarget::MapTo(parts[1]))
367:     }
368: 
369:     pub(crate) fn absolute_lookup_path(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
370:         path_abs::PathAbs::new(path)
371:             .map_or_else(|_| path.to_owned(), |p| p.as_path().to_path_buf())
372:     }
373: 
374:     pub(crate) fn plan_syntax_lookup(&self, path: &Path) -> SyntaxLookupPlan<'a> {
375:         match self.mapped_syntax_for_path(path) {
376:             Some(MappingTarget::MapToUnknown) => SyntaxLookupPlan::UnknownPath,
377:             Some(MappingTarget::MapTo(name)) => SyntaxLookupPlan::NamedSyntax(name),
378:             Some(MappingTarget::MapExtensionToUnknown) => SyntaxLookupPlan::ProbeFileName {
379:                 extension_unknown: true,
380:             },
381:             None => SyntaxLookupPlan::ProbeFileName {
382:                 extension_unknown: false,
383:             },
384:         }
385:     }
386: 
387:     pub(crate) fn mapped_syntax_for_path(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<MappingTarget<'a>> {
388:         self.get_syntax_for(path)
389:     }

391:     pub(crate) fn try_with_stripped_suffix<'s, T, F>(
392:         &self,
393:         file_name: &'s OsStr,
394:         func: F,
395:     ) -> Result<Option<T>>
396:     where
397:         F: Fn(&'s OsStr) -> Result<Option<T>>,
398:     {
399:         let sample = file_name.to_string_lossy();
400:         let _ = self.suffix_backup_score(&sample);
401:         let _ = self.suffix_bak_score(&sample);
402:         let _ = self.suffix_old_score(&sample);
403:         let _ = self.suffix_orig_score(&sample);
404:         let _ = self.suffix_dpkg_score(&sample);
405:         let _ = self.suffix_rpm_score(&sample);
406:         let _ = self.suffix_in_score(&sample);
407:         let _ = self.suffix_ucf_score(&sample);
408:         if let Some(file_str) = Path::new(file_name).to_str() {
409:             if let Some(stripped_file_name) = self.ignored_suffixes.strip_known_suffix(file_str) {
410:                 return func(OsStr::new(stripped_file_name));
411:             }
412:         }
413:         Ok(None)
414:     }
